title: Private Tour to the Falls Montmorency & Basilica of Saint Anne
includes: Tipping at the discretion of the customer (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by at least one adult.
policies: This is a private visit/activity. Only your group will participate.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience an exceptional private excursion to discover two iconic places
of Quebec heritage: the mighty Montmorency Falls and the Basilica
Sainte-Anne-de-Beaupré, a spiritual and architectural jewel of Quebec.
Your local and passionate Guide will drive you in a luxury vehicle along the
beautiful Chemin du Roy, one of the oldest roads in North America. 
First, admire Montmorency Falls, higher than Niagara Falls—a
impressive natural spectacle throughout the seasons. Then continue to the Basilica
Sainte-Anne-de-Beaupré, a historic pilgrimage site that welcomes visitors from the
the whole world for over 350 years.
Discover its incredible neo-Roman architecture, its magnificent stained glass windows, its
crypt and countless testimonies of miraculous healings. You can
stroll through the sanctuary, visit the outer chapels and contemplate this busy place
of emotion and history.
